topic: Number of finance-leasing companies in Vietnam (2025)
claim_a: VCCI report of the Vietnam Leasing Association roundtable (14 August 2025): 9 companies, of which 8 operating, 1 suspended for restructuring and 2 bankrupt, which sums to 11 (SLK-04)
claim_b: Interview with the CEO of BIDV-SuMi Trust Leasing (4 August 2025): eight financial leasing companies operating (SLK-24)
position_taken: Eight operating companies; the total number licensed is unresolved.
notes: Both sources agree on eight operating; the VCCI total is internally inconsistent. Check the SBV list of credit institutions (sbv.gov.vn returned HTTP 403).

claim_a: VND 41,700 billion at 30 June 2025, reported by 6 of 9 companies (SLK-04)
claim_b: About VND 47,000 billion for the whole sector, the association's estimate in the same report (SLK-04)
position_taken: Give both: VND 41,700 billion reported; VND 47,000 billion estimated.
notes: Different coverage, not a contradiction. End-2024: 'just over VND 40 trillion', about 0.26% of credit (SLK-24); 0.25% of credit at mid 2025 (SLK-04).

claim_a: About VND 16,000 billion, stated at the VNBA and IFC roundtable of 12 August 2025 (SLK-06)
claim_b: About VND 22,000 billion, attributed to VNBA in 2026 in a search snippet of a page we could not read (thitruongtaichinhtiente.vn, HTTP 403; not registered)
position_taken: Use VND 16,000 billion (August 2025), the figure read; the snippet may refer to a later date.
notes: Snippet-only evidence is Low. Re-check when the amended factoring circular is issued.
